title: docs(skills): the mobile guide teaches mobileNavMode where it is read, not on the app schema (objectui#11363)
body:
Part of #11363
Clause-②: no

Step B of objectui#11363 under the seat answer on the card (comment 5937316485): the governed guide PR. The named refusal in `@object-ui/types` (B+) is a separate PR and is not in this diff.

⛔ Governed surface (`skills/**`): this PR stays a DRAFT until an authorized approver (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) leaves an APPROVED review; the claiming seat lands it after that. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md` answers GOVERNED (exit 3).

## What changes

One paragraph of `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md`: the sentence that read "set `mobileNavMode` (`'drawer'` | `'bottom_nav'`) on the app schema that `AppSchemaRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`) renders". Nothing reads the key there. The paragraph now teaches the two channels that are read:

- the `mobileNavMode` prop of `AppSchemaRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`);
- the `mobileNavMode` key of the `app-schema-renderer` SDUI node, which `sdui-parser` enum-checks (`invalid-enum` on a misspelling);

and says why the app schema is not a place for it: `@objectstack/spec`'s strict `AppSchema` refuses the key, and the renderer reads only its prop.

No other file. No changeset: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` answers "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed". `skills/**` sits outside every changesets-versioned package (AGENTS.md §9 guards published package source), so the repo rule asks for neither a bump nor an empty-frontmatter declaration; `skip-changeset` has no reader in this repo, so no label either.

## Line readings (`skills/**`, governed; budget net +3)

| reading | before | after | net |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md`, whole file | 168 | 171 | +3 |
| whole bundle, every file under `skills/` (27 files) | 5408 | 5411 | +3 |
| every `SKILL.md` under `skills/`, summed | 142 | 142 | 0 |

`git diff --numstat` for the one file: 6 added, 3 deleted. No token ratchet is defined for `skills/**` in this repo (objectstack's `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` deliberately leaves the published catalog outside its ceilings), so lines are the only reading.

## Measured before writing the sentence (worktree at `d3a60b66`, Node v22.22.2)

**Spec.** `AppSchema.safeParse` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` 17.5.0 (the installed version): a minimal app SUCCESS; the same app plus `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'` FAIL `unrecognized_keys` on `mobileNavMode`; control `notAKey` FAIL `unrecognized_keys`; `'mobileNavMode' in AppSchema.shape` is `false`.

**Channel 1, the prop** (real `AppSchemaRenderer` through `@testing-library/react`; "bar" = the element with role `navigation` and aria-label `Mobile navigation`). Prop `bottom_nav` on a plain document: bar present. The same document carrying `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'` as a document key and no prop: bar absent while the sidebar's `Accounts` link rendered, so the red is not a blank render.

**Channel 2, the SDUI node key** (real `SchemaRenderer` from `@object-ui/react` plus `registerLayout()`). A node `type: app-schema-renderer` carrying `mobileNavMode: bottom_nav`: bar present, sidebar rendered. The same node without the key: bar absent, sidebar rendered (control).

Both probes ran as one temporary test file under the shared verify lock, together with the existing enum pin `appSchemaRendererMobileNavMode.test.tsx` (`invalid-enum` for a misspelling and for the retired value, both legal values clean): `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 9 passed (9)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The probe file was deleted after the run and is not in this diff.

Not run, with the reason: `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-example-ids` scan `content/docs` only (`DOCS_ROOT = 'content/docs'`, and `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`'s header says `skills/objectui/**` is not claimed by any gate there), so they cannot read this diff. No test file reads `guides/mobile.md`: a `git grep` of the path finds `SKILL.md`, `README.md`, `content/docs/guide/agent-skills.md`, comments in `packages/types/src/mobile.ts` and one changeset, none of them a test. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` are CI's runs.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 只改一份对外发布的技能指南 `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md` 里的一段话(净 +3 行)。原文教 AI 把 `mobileNavMode` 写在 app schema 上;现在改教两个真正生效的位置:`AppSchemaRenderer` 组件的 `mobileNavMode` prop,以及 `app-schema-renderer` SDUI 节点上的 `mobileNavMode` 键(`sdui-parser` 会做枚举校验)。并说明 app schema 不是写它的地方:平台 spec 的严格 `AppSchema` 会拒收这个键,渲染器也只读 prop。

**为什么改。** 按原指南写出来的 app,移动端底栏不会出现,也没有任何报错(实测:文档上带这个键、不传 prop,底栏不画;传 prop 或在 SDUI 节点上写键,底栏才画)。同时平台侧 `os validate` 对这个键的回答是拒收。指南在教一个「写了没用、发布会被拒」的键,这是 AI 写元数据最容易掉进去的坑。路线来自 triage 评论自己点名的替代方案,并经席位答复确认:契约优先,spec 拒收的键 objectui 不另读。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 零代码改动、零发布包改动、无 changeset(门禁判定本次不欠)。风险只有一处:文字表述是否准确,而每句都有上面的实测支撑。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,指南回到旧说法。本 PR 是受管面(`skills/**`),须人工批准后才能落地;配套的 B+(让 objectui 自己的 app schema 面也响亮拒收这个键)是另一张单独 PR,不在本 diff 内。

**席位意见。** (留空)

**你要做的。** 若认可措辞,在本 PR 留一条 APPROVED review;认领席随后转 ready 并走合并队列落地。

## Acceptance notes

- Observed, not filed (carrier: none): the `app-schema-renderer` registration declares a `schema` input of type `object`, but `SchemaRenderer` hands the node itself to the component as `schema`, so the node's own top-level keys act as the app document and a nested `schema` object is ignored. No stored producer of such a node is known, so it does not meet the filing bar; the previous dev report on the card records the same reading.
- B+ (objectui's app face refusing `mobileNavMode` by name, as it already does `logo` / `favicon`) is the seat's next PR under its own `Clause-②` line; this PR does not touch `@object-ui/types`.
